resources.string: Get the Data over the TCP connection.
NFCoffee reads the coffee counters from the reader and keeps one counter per NFC card on this phone.

1. Put the reader in transfer mode — it only opens its Wi-Fi network while transferring.
2. Press the coffee cup on the main screen.
3. Confirm the connection to “NFCoffee” when Android asks.
4. When the transfer finishes, the phone returns to the normal network.

If it says the network was not found, or it times out, the reader is probably not in transfer mode yet. Press the cup again.

Manage IDs lists every card. Tap a card to give it a name and an e-mail address; long-press it to select it, then use the bin icon to delete it.\n\n“Delete counters” sets every card back to zero. Do that after the invoice run, not before.

“Export IDs” writes a CSV with the columns NFCID, CODENAME, UNAME, EMAIL, COFF to the location you choose. The same text is shown on screen and can be copied.\n\n“Import IDs” accepts a CSV: paste it, or use “Open file” to load one that was saved earlier. Nothing is written to the database until you press “Import”.

Original app: DSGMedia.ro, 2017.
Redesign and platform update, 2026: RaveGun, with an AI coding assistant (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, OpenCode).
